articles.summary: QXO, Inc. (QXO or the Company) (NYSE: QXO) today announced the following preliminary financial information for the third quarter of 2026. The Company expects to report its full third quarter 2026 results on November 12, 2026. THIRD QUARTER 2026 SUMMARY PRELIMINARY RESULTS Net sales of approximately $4.90 billion, up 79% from $2.73 billion in the third quarter of 2025 GAAP net loss of approximately $123 million, compared to a GAAP net loss of $139 million in the third quarter of 2025 Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP financial measure, of approximately $557 million, up 85% from $301 million in the third quarter of 2025 Third quarter 2026 results include the results of Kodiak Building Partners, Inc. from April 1, 2026 and TopBuild Corp. from July 1, 2026, the respective dates of acquisition, neither of which is included in third quarter 2025 results. The Companys preliminary unaudited financial results in this press release for the third quarter ended
articles.title: QXO Announces Third Quarter 2026 Preliminary Financial Information
